# Claude Cert Prep

> Free, unofficial practice portal for Anthropic's Claude certification program. The Claude Certified Architect — Foundations (CCA-F) track is fully built: a 10,000+ question bank, a 30-lesson curriculum, mock exams, a diagnostic placement test, and spaced-repetition drill — no account or sign-up required. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Anthropic.

## Study tools
- [Mock Exam](https://thatclaude.com/exam): 60 domain-weighted questions, 120-minute timer, scaled 100-1000 score, pass mark 720.
- [Diagnostic](https://thatclaude.com/diagnostic): 25-question untimed placement test with a per-domain study order.
- [Quick Practice](https://thatclaude.com/practice): configurable practice sets by domain and difficulty.
- [Drill](https://thatclaude.com/drill): spaced-repetition review of previously-answered questions.
- [Question Bank](https://thatclaude.com/browse): search all questions with answers and explanations.

## Curriculum and reference
- [Curriculum](https://thatclaude.com/learn): 30 lessons across the 5 CCA-F domains.
- [Glossary](https://thatclaude.com/glossary): exam-focused term definitions per domain.
- [Quick Reference](https://thatclaude.com/reference): condensed decision-rule cheat sheets per domain.
- [How to Pass](https://thatclaude.com/prep): study strategy, mental models, and an FAQ.
- [Blog](https://thatclaude.com/blog): study-strategy and domain deep-dive posts.

## Program
- [Certifications](https://thatclaude.com/certifications): status of all four Anthropic certification tracks (CCA-F is live; CCAR-P, CCAO-F, CCDV-F are in development).
- [About](https://thatclaude.com/about): who built this and why, and how the question bank is generated.

## Exam blueprint (CCA-F)
- Agentic Architecture — 27%
- Tools & MCP — 18%
- Claude Code — 20%
- Prompt Engineering — 20%
- Context & Reliability — 15%
